note: Live off-air decode by navtex.lv (Latvia), pasted from the site's PDF export on 2026-09-08; '_' marks characters the site's decoder could not recover, garbage runs are decoder substitutions. Station letter is the B1 as received; on 518 kHz the letter J is used by Gislövshammar (SE) and by Varna (BG), and night skywave makes Black Sea texts appear under J. Timestamp converted from LV (UTC+3) to UTC.
